title: Molecular Diagnostic Laboratory Services
agency: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.ACQUISITIONS - AQM MOMENTUM
description_text: The U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Global Health Security and Diplomacy (GHSD), is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) in conjunction with the attached DRAFT Performance Work Statement (PWS) for the All-Inclusive Molecular Diagnostic Laboratory Services procurement. The new activity, if awarded, will cover molecular diagnostic laboratory testing and services across Sub-Saharan African and potentially other countries as part of the America First Global Health Security (AFGHS) strategy. Responses to the questions below are requested, but entirely optional, from qualified and eligible manufacturers of molecular diagnostic platforms. Please see the attached DRAFT PWS for eligibility criteria. Responses will be used to inform the final PWS and will not be used for source selection purposes. Where a question asks about specific contracted countries, please address each country individually rather than providing a general response. Where a question asks about current operational data or performance metrics, please provide actual data where available rather than estimates. Respondents are encouraged to answer each question as succinctly as possible (800-character count/question, including spaces). If responding to each question is not feasible, qualified and eligible manufacturers may submit responses to a select number of questions or decide not to respond at all. Not responding to this RFI or providing only limited responses bears no consequence to the outcome of the eventual competition, if any solicitation will be released. Responses are to be submitted via this link: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/g/smW7MpdKHN. Responses should be submitted no later than Wednesday, June 17th, 5:00PM EST. No email responses are accepted; all responses should be submitted through the link provided above. This RFI does not constitute a solicitation and does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation or make an award. No reimbursement will be made for any costs incurred in responding to this RFI.
